NC4_RANDOM_ROLE_NULL as executed is not the frozen control. Frozen definition: random subsets of locatable roles with same cardinality as the canonical tightened set, ranking agreement null. Executed code simulates independent uniform random densities per task (rng2.random()*0.05) and returns agreement of two random rankings (null_mean 0.4989, p95 0.7619 = expected values for independent random permutations); no role sampling, no cardinality constraint. result.json controls.NC4 detail ('1000 perms seed 35725763380+1 same cardinality random subsets') does not describe the executed code. 'null_excess' 0.2154 >= 0.20 therefore is not evidence that canonical ranking is discriminating vs the frozen null.
